title: T-054 PARK_OR_BLOCK re-entry audit for a source-owned owner packet
question: Since DCTRL-000004, is there a new non-synthetic source-owned owner packet or a source-authorized proposition-level counterexample that satisfies the T-054 PARK_OR_BLOCK re-entry contract?
method: Freeze the existing T-054 forward method, the R-192 five-slot order, the R-471 nine-slot admission predicate, and the current PARK_OR_BLOCK blocker; do not add a finite carrier or replace the physical-empty, BCC, or Reading-H routes.

Treat zero-owner and first-missing-slot findings as a hold-for-evidence boundary, not as a universal nonexistence theorem or a promotion to Pre-A, Sector-A, QFT, Yang--Mills, gravity, continuum or mass gap.
decision_scope: T-054 PARK_OR_BLOCK re-entry only. The source search is limited to the maintained E:/Dev/Contents root and the current repository delta after DCTRL-000004; no new finite dynamics or physical branch is instantiated.
finding: No new non-synthetic source-owned owner packet and no source-authorized proposition-level counterexample was found. Since DCTRL-000004 the current branch contains only the R-474 ordered-limit bookkeeping and R-475 A5 Lean sidecar additions plus generated surfaces; no owner source was added. The canonical Contents root has 7,503 files, zero files with creation or modification time after the PARK checkpoint, and its latest file timestamp is 2026-07-07T03:07:39Z. R-459 reproduces 1,442 text paths, 741 unique content hashes, zero complete semantic paths, zero standalone owner paths and zero exact R-192 tokens. R-460 reproduces 284 text paths, 273 unique content hashes, zero complete semantic paths, zero standalone owner paths and zero exact R-192 tokens. R-192 remains a 58/58 verifier PASS with trial verdict FAIL_FIRST_MISSING_PRODUCTION_MAP at heat_root_incidence. R-471 remains EMPTY_OWNER_ARTIFACT with zero admitted candidates and all nine slots false; its primary, independent, hostile, integrated and Lean lanes pass. The re-entry condition is therefore not met.
decision_reason: The only admissible re-entry evidence is a new, non-synthetic, versioned source packet that fills every declared owner field, or a source-authorized proposition-level counterexample that directly falsifies a compatibility requirement. The two complementary source audits find neither; the post-PARK filesystem and repository checks show no new owner input. Existing finite and conditional authorities remain comparison or firewall evidence and cannot be relabelled as the missing owner.
